voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, Juanito (u1CVBnSUn9JiL8ssgd2v), Taglish, one take, split into lines, inner pauses capped at 0.32 s, no tempo change

lines.text: Labing-isa kami sa UV. Sa salamin ng bintana, labintatlo.
lines.beat_before: hook: the dark side window; in it the rear bench, and two pale women right beside me, heads turned to me

lines.text: Alas-dos ng madaling-araw. Huling biyahe pauwi galing sa trabaho.
lines.beat_before: the UV Express alone on a night avenue under sodium lamps

lines.text: Sa tabi ko, dalawang babae. Sa bawat lubak, umuuga kaming lahat. Sila, hindi.
lines.beat_before: from the front: the passengers sway with a bump; the two women beside me do not move

lines.text: Naglaro na lang ako sa cellphone. Para hindi ko sila tingnan.
lines.beat_before: my phone: a game glowing; at the edge, their knees, perfectly still

lines.text: Pero sa bintana, kita ko. Nakaharap silang dalawa sa akin.
lines.beat_before: the window: in the reflection both their heads turn, too far, in jerks, to face me
I turn: the two seats beside me are empty

lines.text: Walang huminto. Walang bumaba. Mainit pa ang upuan.
lines.beat_before: my hand on the empty vinyl, still dented; the van keeps going, nobody looks up

lines.text: Pagtingin ko ulit sa bintana... nandiyan pa rin sila. Mas malapit.
lines.beat_before: the window again: they are in it, closer, at my shoulder
